title: Kissed Pillowy Slovakian Eggplant Casserole
description: A romantic Slovakian dish featuring eggplant, this casserole is winey and pillowy, perfect for a special occasion, and is jain-friendly as it contains no animal products.
instructions: Preheat the iron teppan to medium high heat.
Brush both sides of the eggplant slices with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Add the eggplant slices to the iron teppan and cook for 3 minutes on each side, or until they are tender and lightly browned.
Remove the eggplant slices from the iron teppan and set them aside on a plate.
Add the chopped onion to the iron teppan and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the iron teppan and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the red wine, tomato puree, and vegetable broth to the iron teppan, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
To assemble the casserole, create a layer of eggplant slices in the bottom of the iron teppan, followed by a layer of the wine and tomato mixture, and finally a sprinkle of nutritional yeast.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of eggplant slices on top.
Cover the iron teppan with a lid and simmer the casserole over low heat for 20 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together and the eggplant is very tender.
